|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Spice Mine Administrator. The image is the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Moruth_Doole_Kessel_Administrator.png]]), which prints it. The later version [[Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator (V)]] (PC-E1, the current card) has the same game text under the title •Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed as “•Spice Mine Administrator” on the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011), p. 3<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, and listed under that title, with the same text, on the PC website card list from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-old-moruth">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploys -1 to Kessel. While at a Kessel battleground site, your Force drains are +1 at X related locations, where X = number of 'spice' cards on Spice Mine Operations, and once per turn, may use 3 Force to take a 'spice' card you own into hand.” The slip has no lore.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator (V)]]): the title changed to “•Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 14 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-moruth">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314031820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130516000419/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-05-16]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, PDF page 12)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-9-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-moruthdoolekesseladministrator-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
